name: @typecrate/nexus
description: Outbound-dial inference broker: a Rust (axum + tokio) hub that queues consumer jobs and streams results back over one persistent worker connection.
#main: No entry point: this package publishes nothing and no other package imports it. The npm layer exists only to give the Rust workspace a verb list and the Daytona/Modal deploy scripts a runner.

scripts.#toolchain: Every Rust script runs the pinned toolchain via `rustup run` when rustup is present; see README 'Verification status' for this host.
scripts.#deploy:endpoint: The platform-neutral verb: ONE URL argument (Daytona runner preview URL, Modal box/sandbox URL, loopback runner). It gates on GET /health (sandbox runtime v2: apiVersion >= 2 or capabilities [apps]) and reads the named app at GET /apps/nexus: absent = POST /apps; ready|failed = PUT /apps/nexus (blue-green, peers untouched); queued|building|booting|draining = DELETE /apps/nexus then POST; --teardown = DELETE /apps/nexus and verifies the record is 404. It never uses the v1 /status alias or a root slot. The Modal container recycle (DELETE /_provider/sandbox, which discards EVERY app on the box) is opt-in only via --recycle-container and is refused for non-Modal endpoints and Modal sandbox tunnels. scripts/deploy-endpoint.ts.
scripts.#daytona: deploy:daytona ships bytes to an ENDPOINT THAT ALREADY EXISTS; start:daytona is the orchestrator that creates the sandbox first (scripts/start-daytona.ts header). vite-node is root-hoisted, so the TS script runs with no build step.
scripts.#ts: The TypeScript surface is scripts/*.ts ONLY (the Rust crates are checked by cargo, and every host script runs on the root-hoisted vite-node — no build step, no raw node). test:scripts covers the scripts; `test` stays cargo, which turbo orchestrates.
scripts.#test:scripts: Covers the tsx lifecycle scripts by glob (scripts/*.test.ts): start-daytona's parser/plan/argv/modes/admin-credential handoff/interrupt guard, deploy-daytona's parser, auth matrix, tar packing, v2 request shape, plan, retry policy and poll state machine, and deploy-endpoint's cold-start/auth/dead probe table, v2 health gate, app-scoped replace policy, explicit Modal recycle, child argv and hub-URL reporting. Every side effect is injected — no network, no cargo, no sandbox — and counts are deliberately not restated here (drift).
scripts.verify: yarn fmt:check && yarn clippy && yarn test && yarn build

#dependencies: scripts/start-daytona.ts imports createSandbox from @services/daytona/sandbox, and scripts/start-modal.ts reads the Modal box URL from @config/vault; house convention is "*" + TS sources resolved through the workspace symlink (no build step, no lockfile entry needed for a private workspace package).
